context_for_next_testing_agent: All mantras (OM and non-OM) now use chant-style audio via playChantForMantra function in MantraAudio.js. The function uses Web Audio API to generate syllable-based chanting sounds with base frequencies determined by mantra text. Guided overlays have single 'Play Voice Guidance' button with Voice/Speed override dropdowns. All duplicate Voice Options controls have been removed. Console 401 errors are expected for unauthenticated users (favorites API). Console 403 error for OM audio URL is expected since OM uses generated sound primarily.
